title: Modicon M580
summary: Ethernet-based process controller with X80 I/O, engineered in EcoStruxure Control Expert.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: M580 CPUs sit in an Ethernet backplane with X80 I/O modules; remote drops connect over Ethernet. Hot standby configurations are common in process plants.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: Choose the profile `schneider.m580` for a Free Lab project to see digital I/O as IEC direct addresses such as `%IX0.0` and `%QX0.1` and analog channels as `%IW` words, and analog raw values 0..10000 for the nominal range. The PLC is still PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are PLC Lab Structured Text, not the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog values use the PLC Lab 0..10000 convention
Hot standby and remote drops are not simulated
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
